newsitem.title: USA: Texas Stock Index breaks past 300 - Comptroller.
newsitem.headline: Texas Stock Index breaks past 300 - Comptroller.

text.p: The Texas Stock Index has surpassed the "300 mark" for the first time in its history, a release from State Comptroller John Sharp said Thursday.
Sharp's office produces the monthly Texas Stock Index to track prices of selected Texas companies, and measure investors' confidence in Texas businesses.

"After losing a little bit of ground in March, the TSI more than made up for it in April, rising 21.8 points, or 7.6 percent, to stand at 310.2. The index is currently 35.4 percent higher than one year ago," Sharp said.
"In comparison, the Standard & Poor's 500, which tracks a nationwide sampling of stock prices, rose 44.2 points, or 5.8 percent in April."
